name: Pulse
tagline: Dark-first SaaS landing theme: violet glow, bold geometric type, pricing, FAQ.
longDescription:
Pulse is a launch-ready theme for software products and startups. It is dark first: a near-black page with a violet cast, lit by soft radial glows in the brand violet (#6D28D9) and a magenta partner, with headlines set tight in Sora and running text in Inter.

It ships seven pages built from its own component library: a landing page (glowing hero with a framed product screenshot, customer logos strip, six-card feature grid, stats, an alternating feature story, testimonial, three-tier pricing table with a highlighted plan, FAQ and a gradient call-to-action band), a product tour, a pricing page, an about page with team and gallery, a blog index with post cards, a contact page and a 404.

Fourteen components come with it — header, footer, two heroes, logos strip, feature grid, testimonial, pricing table, FAQ, CTA band, gallery, team, contact block and blog card — each with editable props and, where it makes sense, variants. Everything is drawn narrow-first and widens by breakpoint, uses design tokens rather than literal colours for all text, and keeps secondary text at 4.5:1 or better on every surface.

Photography is original and generated for this theme, with a diverse cast and a consistent violet dusk grade; the product screenshot is a rendered mock you can swap for your own.
